plain_language: A new paper closes the last gap in the AI-safety verification chain. The US safety order deadline is now two days away. Cerebras steady near $199 ahead of Thursday's big analyst event.
findings:
Tuesday's signal extends Monday's execution cycle one further surface upstream and one further surface downstream at the same time, with the day's defining new datum landing where the loader-verification line meets the tenant-policy attestation gate. A Tuesday arxiv release (2605.07735) extends the line from Monday's training-pipeline checkpoint-provenance surface to a tenant-policy-attestation surface, presenting a verification model that binds the training-surface signed-checkpoint provenance chain to a per-tenant policy-attestation manifest covering the fifteen-jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter's tenant-policy field schemas, with the paper positioned as a third extension of the consolidated 2605.07241 framework after its 2605.07412 empirical companion and Monday's 2605.07588 training-surface extension. Simon Willison characterizes the result as the loader-verification line reaching its third documented extension inside a May 16-19 four-day cluster, the three papers plus the original framework now forming a unified four-document reference set the framework maintainer cohort's coordinated mid-June default-shipment commitment can cite as a single coherent surface, and andrew.ooo confirms the reproduction harness extends the existing DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft consolidated reference-implementation index to cover the new tenant-policy-attestation manifest. The implementation cohort is already wiring the new hooks: vLLM opens a v0.11.5 development branch adding the training-surface checkpoint-provenance verification hook as a paving step on top of the existing five-surface mitigation set, Unsloth wires the optional verification step directly into its router-only training driver, and the Mistral Workflows five-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix conformance suite already folds the training-surface check into a green test cycle for a second consecutive weekday. Both feed the unified loader-verification model ships as framework default by mid-June 2026 prediction (May 16) and the open-source serving stacks signed-checkpoint loading prediction (May 12), carried strong.

The day's most coherent cross-stream pattern is procurement, governance, and product clocks all compressing toward the same Friday May 22 inflection. The CISA federal-civilian operational directive incorporating the eleven-CVE Trail of Bits agent-loader taxonomy moves from Monday's publication to its first full operating day, the federal-civilian remediation deadline for the n8n CVE-2026-21858 weekday-descent now at T-minus-two business days against a Shadowserver Tuesday scan of roughly 1,395 internet-exposed pre-1.121.0 instances (down from Monday's 1,640) and a residual long-tail unpatched share easing to about 10 percent, Censys exploitation telemetry settling flat at 1.7x baseline rather than ramping into the deadline. On the governance leg, the Frontier Model Review Board executive order enters its fourth calendar day of the ten-business-day classified-annex response clock, the deadline at T-minus-two business days against the same Friday May 22 expiry, with the CISA Director's office filing the second substantive submission against the Senate Cyber Subcommittee's classified-annex follow-up question set on top of Monday's first submission from NIST Director Locascio's office and two of eight witnesses now on record inside the first two business days on the steeper cadence the slate had targeted. The House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee on Communications and Technology converts Monday's markup-scheduling decision into a Tuesday-morning posted markup notice for the parallel 30-day technical-review joint-resolution draft, the first formal House-track movement on the Frontier Model Review Board track since the order's signing window opened. The OECD GENAI member-state schema-comment submissions move past three-quarters of the candidate cohort on schedule for the June 2-6 plenary at T-minus-two weeks, the fifteen-jurisdiction perimeter holds with Qatar's 270-day consultation window into its second week, the five-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix holds its first-week-of-June general-availability target with the conformance suite green for a second consecutive weekday, and the Anthropic Mythos-Preview gated cohort adds two further Indo-Pacific allied public-sector tenants to reach 68 with the open-source verification harness reproducing the deterministic per-tenant attestation-log audit trail under 55 seconds.

Defensive telemetry keeps tightening on the weekday tempo with each consecutive-day counter ticking up one. Sysdig holds the unprotected-estate credential-extraction median at five minutes for an eighth consecutive day against a 5.6-hour Defender-protected window (a 67x gap), Wiz reports the Defender for Cloud quarantine rate on net-new MCP servers ticking to 49 percent for a ninth consecutive expansion day against a roughly 8,960-server estate, Cisco-Astrix identity-gateway tenancy edges to about 2,455 enterprise tenants with Akamai SkyAtlas near 1,410, and CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI holds four-orchestrator managed visibility near 91 percent into the Tuesday open. The agentic-AI tooling-stack CVE wave holds flat at eleven catalogued instances into the second business-week day, with the loader-verification storyline now anchored to a settled four-document academic reference set plus a published federal directive plus a mid-June default-shipment commitment, giving any framework releasing the default ahead of mid-June a fully-pinned alignment story per Simon Willison.

The markets stream resumes weekday motion into a T-minus-two analyst-day catalyst without yet resolving. Cerebras CBRS opens Tuesday with the market's follow-through session after Monday's first re-rating of the four-consecutive-day consolidation base, the five-desk spread carrying unchanged into the second trading day inside the same roughly $185-to-$235 band — Bernstein's $185 floor, Morgan Stanley's $192 with the upside-scenario probability nudging from 41 to 42 percent, Wells Fargo Securities at $208, Jefferies at $225, and UBS at $205 — with institutional-buyside cumulative net position edging from roughly 37 to roughly 38 percent of float and the Saudi PIF contingent-secondary discussion stepping into its second week of the 10-21 day execution window. The six-desk Mag-7 preview cohort nudges the Alphabet Q2 AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout probability from Monday's 88 percent to 89 percent against the unchanged Friday SEC Corp Fin fourth sample comment letter as the settled disclosure-precedent input, with the VentureBeat aggregation reiterating cohort consensus that Microsoft, Meta, and AWS follow with their own AI Services revenue breakouts in their fiscal Q3 2026 prints. Tenstorrent's Corp Fin first-round comment-letter response moves to its twelve-business-day mark inside the staff-review interval ahead of a likely second-round letter and holds an early-August public-filing target, SambaNova's bookrunner roster stays at six toward a final-week-of-June confidential submission, and AMD's Helios plus MI450 commitment book advances from near 10.4GW to near 10.55GW with a fresh sovereign-cloud commitment. Tenstorrent Wormhole Galaxy-rack capacity advances from roughly 177 to roughly 187 racks against the 280-rack first-half target (about 67 percent fulfilled, a four-point uptick), the additions spread across CoreWeave and Lambda Labs in North America plus a second Asia-Pacific increment to Yotta Labs India and a small European sovereign-cloud re-up adding UpCloud Finland and Telefonica Tech Spain. Two dormant longshots remain quiet on Tuesday — the foundation-labs audited monthly revenue prediction (Apr 30) and the LLM-tooling-plus-Linux-kernel CVE-chain prediction (May 2) — neither getting the audited monthly-revenue cadence nor an IR-firm kernel-chain post-mortem each specifically calls for.
